audience: Gamma is for people who need a deck, a one-pager, or a simple site quickly and are willing to start on a free plan while the paid dollar price is unclear. Students, founders sketching a pitch, and marketers who would rather generate slides than fight a template are the fit. If you need a contract with a published seat price before you roll it out, this is the wrong week to standardize on Gamma.

It is a bad fit if your buying process requires the number on gamma.app/pricing. On 14 October 2026 that page timed out, and a direct download returned HTTP 403. We will not fill the gap with an old $12 or $25 figure. Those earlier numbers are not confirmed.
features: The free plan is not a timed trial. It is $0 with 400 starting credits, and those credits do not refresh. You can learn the editor and ship a small deck without a card. That is why the verdict says there is a real free plan, and why the rating stays Pending instead of Skip.

Plus is the plan that removes the Gamma badge. The help center lists Plus at 1,000 credits a month, Pro at 4,000 credits a month, and Ultra at 20,000 credits a month. Ultra is monthly-only for now. Annual plans are 28% off when you can see the price. The help center does not state the Plus or Pro dollar amount, so this page does not either.

Generation is the product. You describe the deck and Gamma drafts the cards. That is faster than building slide by slide, and it is also why credits exist. A heavy generation habit hits the gate even if the dollar price is hidden. The cons line says that plainly.
limitations: We do not know what Plus or Pro costs in dollars today. The official pricing page did not load. Publishing a guessed price would be worse than the Pending rating. Check the vendor before you pay, and treat any number you see only on a review site, including an older version of this one, as unverified.

Free credits do not refresh. 400 starting credits is a pile, not a monthly allowance. When they are gone, you are on a paid plan or you are done. Plus, Pro, and Ultra are monthly credit amounts, which is a different meter. Do not mix those up when you compare Gamma with a tool that bills a flat seat.

The Gamma badge stays on the free plan. If the deck is client-facing, that watermark is the reason to look at Plus, and Plus is also the plan whose price we could not read. Beautiful.ai is the alternative with a number.

The plan itself is not described as time-limited. The 400 starting credits do not refresh. When the credits are gone, the free generation is gone with them.
The help center says Ultra is monthly-only for now. Plus and Pro can be annual, at 28% off, but only once you can see the price. We are not calculating that discount into dollars.

faqs.q: Why is Gamma not rated Worth it?
faqs.a: The product is fine to try, and the free plan is real. A Worth it rating needs a price we verified. We do not have one for Plus or Pro. Pending is the honest rating, and a pending affiliate program would not promote it.
